observed_signature: BrowserType.connect_over_cdp timed out after the websocket connected.
cause: A foreign debugger-controlled tab or frozen target may have blocked Playwright attach; the receipt does not isolate which cause occurred.
fix: Inspect the owned browser profile and current target state; retain the bounded attach timeout and do not terminate an unowned process.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not match ordinary page.goto timeouts without a CDP attach signature.

observed_signature: Existing voice chapters had no matching adaptive recipe.
cause: The cited receipt attributes this incident to CRLF recipe bytes being read in text mode; verify the exact input bytes before generalizing.
fix: Use the supported recipe rebuild path after confirming the current narration bytes and recipe inputs.
false_positive_boundaries: A missing recipe can have causes other than newline normalization.

observed_signature: The logged AI Studio click was intercepted by a CDK overlay subtree.
cause: An overlay intercepted the target click in this recorded attempt; the receipt does not establish that every overlay is transient or safe to dismiss.
fix: Classify the visible overlay through the existing UI guard; only retry when the prior action is known not to have sent.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not treat unrelated locator timeouts or historical overlays as a current visible blocker.

observed_signature: AI Studio returned HTTP status code 0 after one recorded Run click; the receipt says no audio was downloaded.
cause: The receipt records a failed provider response but does not establish whether the cause was network, browser, or provider-side.
fix: Preserve the spent-attempt receipt and inspect current evidence; retry only under a fresh explicit provider grant.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not classify other HTTP status codes or infer that a request was unsent from status 0.

observed_signature: The diagnostic receipt records analyze navigation timeouts and slow local proxy/VPN probes with zero provider sends in that diagnostic.
cause: The local proxy/VPN path was degraded during the diagnostic; this does not prove it caused a separate provider failure.
fix: Run the approved local network health check before a separately authorized request; preserve provider-send accounting independently.
false_positive_boundaries: A navigation timeout alone does not prove proxy failure or establish whether a separate request was sent.

observed_signature: The local TTS send guard refused a further attempt after the attempt ceiling was reached.
cause: The local attempt budget was spent; this does not report provider quota state.
fix: Keep the journal spent; a new attempt requires a separate user grant and a fresh journal.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not infer that a provider request was sent solely from this guard refusal.

observed_signature: The cited attempt stopped on a SyntaxError in production/writing.py while edits were in progress; its receipt reports zero sends.
cause: The receipt attributes this specific import failure to an edit in progress; other import errors need independent diagnosis.
fix: Repair the syntax error and verify the exact attempt's send receipt before making any send-status claim.
false_positive_boundaries: Only match import/syntax failures whose recorded frame is production/writing.py; never infer send status from the exception type.
